data_quality_note: Transcribed from 18 screenshots covering 13 tool series (Deburring Brush, File, Knife, with Borescope, Nylon Cup/End/Tube/Wheel Brush, Rotary Burr, Wire Cup/End/Tube/Wheel Brush). Verified that Nylon Cup/End/Tube/Wheel Brush share identical Linear Speed values across all 4 series (differ only in Tool Life Cost / Deburr Type), and likewise for Wire Cup/End/Tube/Wheel Brush - this served as a cross-check on the transcription. Also note: Nylon Wheel Brush shows Tool Life Cost = $10.00 for codes 20.11-20.33 and 23.1, vs $120.00 for all other codes in that series - kept as read, not corrected.
